# Portfolio
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Jesna Joshy — AI &amp; Computer Vision Engineer</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500;1,600&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --maroon:#7a1f2b;
  --maroon-deep:#5c1620;
  --cream:#f7f2ec;
  --cream-deep:#efe6db;
  --ink:#2b211f;
  --ink-soft:#6f6360;
  --gold:#c9a45c;
  --line:#e2d6c8;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{
  background:var(--cream);
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.7;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
.wrap{max-width:1140px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px;}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:var(--ink);}
em{font-style:italic;color:var(--maroon);}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

/* ===== NAV ===== */
nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;
  background:rgba(247,242,236,0.92);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.nav-inner{
  max-width:1140px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 32px;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
}
.nav-logo{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:22px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;}
.nav-logo em{font-style:italic;}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:36px;list-style:none;}
.nav-links a{
  color:var(--ink-soft);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:0.03em;transition:color 0.2s;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a:focus-visible{color:var(--maroon);}
.nav-links a:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--maroon);outline-offset:4px;}
@media(max-width:760px){.nav-links{display:none;}}

/* ===== HERO ===== */
.hero{
  min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;
  padding-top:90px;
  position:relative;
}
.hero-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;
  gap:60px;align-items:center;
  width:100%;
}
.hero-eyebrow{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
  font-size:13px;color:var(--maroon);
  letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:20px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
}
.hero-eyebrow::before{content:'';width:36px;height:1px;background:var(--maroon);display:inline-block;}

.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(48px,7vw,86px);
  line-height:1.05;
  margin-bottom:24px;
}
.hero-sub{
  font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,20px);
  color:var(--ink-soft);
  max-width:480px;
  margin-bottom:36px;
}
.hero-sub strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}

.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:48px;}
.btn{
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  font-size:14px;font-weight:600;
  padding:15px 32px;
  text-decoration:none;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  transition:all 0.25s;
  letter-spacing:0.02em;
  border-radius:2px;
}
.btn-fill{background:var(--maroon);color:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--maroon);}
.btn-fill:hover,.btn-fill:focus-visible{background:var(--maroon-deep);}
.btn-outline{color:var(--maroon);border:1px solid var(--maroon);background:transparent;}
.btn-outline:hover,.btn-outline:focus-visible{background:var(--maroon);color:var(--cream);}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px;}

.hero-stats{
  display:flex;gap:40px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.hero-stats .stat b{
  display:block;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:32px;font-weight:700;color:var(--maroon);
}
.hero-stats .stat span{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);letter-spacing:0.04em;text-transform:uppercase;}

/* Hero photo */
.hero-photo-wrap{
  position:relative;
  display:flex;justify-content:center;
}
.hero-photo{
  width:100%;max-width:420px;aspect-ratio:1/1.12;
  position:relative;
  border-radius:4px;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 24px 60px -20px rgba(122,31,43,0.35);
}
.hero-photo img{
  width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;
  display:block;
  filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.05) brightness(1.02);
}
.hero-photo::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(122,31,43,0.38), rgba(122,31,43,0.12) 55%, transparent 80%);
  mix-blend-mode:multiply;
}
.hero-photo-frame{
  position:absolute;inset:18px;
  border:1px solid rgba(247,242,236,0.55);
  border-radius:2px;
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:2;
}
.photo-tag{
  position:absolute;bottom:24px;left:24px;z-index:3;
  background:var(--cream);color:var(--maroon);
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
  padding:8px 16px;letter-spacing:0.05em;
  border-radius:2px;
}

@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;}
  .hero-eyebrow{justify-content:center;}
  .hero-eyebrow::before{display:none;}
  .hero-sub{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .hero-cta{justify-content:center;}
  .hero-stats{justify-content:center;}
  .hero-photo-wrap{order:-1;}
  .hero-photo{max-width:320px;}
}

/* ===== SECTION SHARED ===== */
section{padding:110px 0;}
.section-head{margin-bottom:64px;text-align:center;}
.section-eyebrow{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--maroon);
  letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;display:block;
}
.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5.5vw,56px);}
.section-head p{color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:560px;margin:18px auto 0;font-size:17px;}

.alt-bg{background:var(--cream-deep);}

/* ===== ABOUT ===== */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center;}
.about-text p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:17px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.about-text p strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}
.about-quote{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;
  font-size:26px;color:var(--maroon);line-height:1.4;
  border-left:3px solid var(--gold);padding-left:24px;margin-bottom:24px;
}
.detail-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;}
.detail-row{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.detail-row:first-child{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
.detail-row span:first-child{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;
}
.detail-row span:last-child{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);}
@media(max-width:850px){.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px;}}

/* ===== SKILLS ===== */
.skill-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;}
.skill-card{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:32px 28px;
  border-radius:4px;transition:transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
}
.skill-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 16px 40px -24px rgba(122,31,43,0.4);}
.skill-card .num{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:34px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);
  margin-bottom:14px;display:block;
}
.skill-card h3{font-size:21px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.skill-card .tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
.skill-card .tags span{
  font-size:12px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
  color:var(--maroon);border:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--cream-deep);
}
@media(max-width:850px){.skill-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
@media(max-width:560px){.skill-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* ===== EXPERIENCE ===== */
.exp-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;}
.exp-card{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:160px 1fr;gap:40px;
  padding:40px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.exp-card:first-child{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
.exp-date{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--maroon);
  letter-spacing:0.04em;line-height:1.6;
}
.exp-date .badge{
  display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;
  background:var(--maroon);color:var(--cream);
  font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.1em;
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.exp-card h3{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:4px;}
.exp-card .org{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:500;}
.exp-card ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
.exp-card li{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:15px;padding-left:22px;position:relative;}
.exp-card li::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:9px;width:8px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .exp-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;}
}

/* ===== PROJECTS ===== */
.proj-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:28px;}
.proj-card{
  background:#fff;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  transition:transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.proj-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 20px 50px -28px rgba(122,31,43,0.45);}
.proj-top{
  background:var(--maroon);color:var(--cream);
  padding:24px 28px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
}
.proj-top .pyear{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0.08em;opacity:0.85;}
.proj-top h3{color:var(--cream);font-size:22px;}
.proj-body{padding:28px;flex-grow:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.proj-body p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-grow:1;}
.proj-body .stack{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
.proj-body .stack span{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;
  color:var(--maroon);background:var(--cream-deep);padding:4px 10px;
  border-radius:20px;
}
.proj-card.featured{grid-column:span 2;}
.proj-card.featured .proj-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:24px;align-items:center;}
.proj-card.featured .proj-body p{margin-bottom:0;}
@media(max-width:850px){
  .proj-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .proj-card.featured{grid-column:span 1;}
  .proj-card.featured .proj-body{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}

/* ===== CERTIFICATIONS ===== */
.cert-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:20px;max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;}
.cert-card{
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;
  padding:24px 26px;display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start;
}
.cert-num{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:28px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);
  flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;
}
.cert-card h4{font-size:17px;margin-bottom:4px;line-height:1.35;}
.cert-card .org{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:13px;}
.cert-card .date{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--maroon);
  margin-top:8px;display:block;letter-spacing:0.04em;
}
@media(max-width:700px){.cert-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* ===== EDUCATION ===== */
.edu-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:24px;max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;}
.edu-card{
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:32px;
  background:#fff;text-align:center;
}
.edu-card .yr{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:var(--maroon);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:12px;letter-spacing:0.08em;}
.edu-card h4{font-size:21px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.edu-card .org{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:14px;}
@media(max-width:700px){.edu-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* ===== CONTACT ===== */
.contact-section{
  background:var(--maroon);color:var(--cream);
  text-align:center;border-radius:4px;
  padding:90px 40px;
}
.contact-section .section-eyebrow{color:var(--gold);}
.contact-section h2{color:var(--cream);font-size:clamp(36px,6.5vw,68px);max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 24px;line-height:1.15;}
.contact-section h2 em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic;}
.contact-section p{color:rgba(247,242,236,0.75);font-size:18px;margin-bottom:48px;max-width:520px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
.contact-grid{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.contact-card{
  border:1px solid rgba(247,242,236,0.3);border-radius:2px;
  padding:22px 32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  text-decoration:none;color:var(--cream);min-width:170px;
  transition:all 0.2s;
}
.contact-card:hover,.contact-card:focus-visible{background:rgba(247,242,236,0.1);border-color:var(--gold);}
.contact-card .label{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.contact-card .val{font-size:15px;font-weight:500;}

footer{
  padding:36px 0;text-align:center;
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);
}
footer em{color:var(--maroon);font-style:italic;}

@media(max-width:700px){
  section{padding:70px 0;}
  .hero{padding-top:100px;}
  .contact-section{padding:60px 24px;}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none !important;animation:none !important;}}
</style>
</head>

<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="hero-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="hero-eyebrow">AI &amp; Computer Vision Engineer</div>
        <h1>Hi, I'm<br><em>Jesna</em> Joshy</h1>
        <p class="hero-sub">
          I build <strong>real-time computer vision and machine learning systems</strong> — from object detection with YOLOv8 to deep learning pipelines with TensorFlow. Currently exploring LLMs and Generative AI too.
        </p>
        <div class="hero-cta">
          <a href="#projects" class="btn btn-fill">view my work</a>
          <a href="#contact" class="btn btn-outline">let's connect</a>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-stats">
          <div class="stat"><b>5+</b><span>Certifications</span></div>
          <div class="stat"><b>4</b><span>Projects Built</span></div>
          <div class="stat"><b>2025</b><span>BSc Computer Science</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-photo-wrap">
        <div class="hero-photo">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Jesna Joshy">
          <div class="hero-photo-frame"></div>
          <div class="photo-tag">Open to AI/ML Roles</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<section id="about">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-eyebrow">about me</span>
      <h2>From data to <em>decisions</em></h2>
    </div>
    <div class="about-grid">
      <div class="about-text">
        <p class="about-quote">"I like turning messy, real-world problems into systems that can see, learn, and decide."</p>
        <p>I'm an <strong>AI &amp; Computer Vision Engineer</strong> currently working as a <strong>Junior AI &amp; Computer Vision Trainee at Kalgus Labs</strong>, where I build real-time object detection pipelines using YOLOv8 and OpenCV for industrial safety compliance.</p>
        <p>Before this, I spent 10 months as a <strong>Data Science Intern at Quest Innovative Solutions</strong>, working with EDA, machine learning models, and dashboards — building a strong foundation in data-driven thinking.</p>
        <p>I hold a <strong>BSc in Computer Science</strong> and an <strong>Advanced Diploma in AI &amp; Machine Learning</strong>, and I'm now looking to grow further as an AI/ML Engineer, Computer Vision Engineer, or Data Scientist.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-list">
        <div class="detail-row"><span>Location</span><span>Ernakulam, Kerala</span></div>
        <div class="detail-row"><span>Current Role</span><span>Jr. AI &amp; CV Trainee</span></div>
        <div class="detail-row"><span>Company</span><span>Kalgus Labs</span></div>
        <div class="detail-row"><span>Core Focus</span><span>Computer Vision &amp; ML</span></div>
        <div class="detail-row"><span>Also Exploring</span><span>LLMs &amp; GenAI</span></div>
        <div class="detail-row"><span>Availability</span><span style="color:var(--maroon)">Open to opportunities</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="skills" class="alt-bg">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-eyebrow">what i work with</span>
      <h2>Skills &amp; <em>Expertise</em></h2>
      <p>A toolkit built around computer vision, deep learning, and data — with growing interest in generative AI.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="skill-grid">
      <div class="skill-card">
        <span class="num">01</span>
        <h3>Computer Vision</h3>
        <div class="tags">
          <span>YOLOv8</span><span>OpenCV</span><span>Roboflow</span>
          <span>Object Detection</span><span>Image Classification</span>
        </div>
      </div>

        <span class="num">02</span>
        <h3>Deep Learning</h3>
        <div class="tags">
          <span>TensorFlow</span><span>PyTorch</span><span>Keras</span>
          <span>CNN</span><span>RNN</span><span>ANN</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-card">
        <span class="num">03</span>
        <h3>Machine Learning</h3>
        <div class="tags">
          <span>Scikit-learn</span><span>Regression</span><span>Classification</span>
          <span>Clustering</span><span>Feature Engineering</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-card">
        <span class="num">04</span>
        <h3>NLP &amp; GenAI</h3>
        <div class="tags">
          <span>NLTK</span><span>TF-IDF</span><span>LLMs</span>
          <span>Prompt Engineering</span><span>AI Chatbots</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-card">
        <span class="num">05</span>
        <h3>Data Analysis</h3>
        <div class="tags">
          <span>Pandas</span><span>NumPy</span><span>Seaborn</span>
          <span>Matplotlib</span><span>Tableau</span><span>EDA</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-card">
        <span class="num">06</span>
        <h3>Development</h3>
        <div class="tags">
          <span>Python</span><span>Django</span><span>SQL</span>
          <span>MySQL</span><span>HTML/CSS</span><span>REST APIs</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="experience">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-eyebrow">my journey so far</span>
      <h2>Work <em>Experience</em></h2>
    </div>
    <div class="exp-list">
      <div class="exp-card">
        <div class="exp-date">May 2026 — Present<br><span class="badge">Current</span></div>
        <div>
          <h3>Junior AI &amp; Computer Vision Trainee</h3>
          <div class="org">Kalgus Labs Pvt Ltd · Ernakulam</div>
          <ul>
            <li>Developing and testing real-time object detection pipelines using YOLOv8 and OpenCV for industrial safety-compliance use cases.</li>
            <li>Designing and preprocessing custom image datasets with Roboflow — annotation, augmentation, and validation.</li>
            <li>Training and optimizing CNN-based deep learning models for image classification and detection.</li>
            <li>Integrating Computer Vision modules with Python-based backend services via RESTful APIs.</li>
            <li>Researching advanced CV techniques including pose estimation and semantic segmentation.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="exp-card">
        <div class="exp-date">Jul 2025 — Apr 2026</div>
        <div>
          <h3>Data Science Intern</h3>
          <div class="org">Quest Innovative Solution · Ernakulam</div>
          <ul>
            <li>Performed Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on real-world datasets using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.</li>
            <li>Built and evaluated ML models for classification and regression tasks with Scikit-learn.</li>
            <li>Applied NLP text preprocessing — TF-IDF, Bag of Words, NLTK pipelines.</li>
            <li>Created visual dashboards using Tableau and executed SQL queries for reporting.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="projects" class="alt-bg">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-eyebrow">selected work</span>
      <h2>Featured <em>Projects</em></h2>
